usedFor: Lemlist holds your outreach campaigns, and Google Sheets keeps a suppression list that “Add New Row to Sheet” extends.

bestTemplate.name: “Unsubscribed Recipient” in Lemlist, then “Add New Row to Sheet” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Each unsubscribe lands as a new sheet row, giving you one list of people to leave out.

watchOut: “Unsubscribed Recipient” in Lemlist is polling, so a row can trail the unsubscribe by one check.
